notes.summary: The page contrasts the subdivision order with the earlier straight order, defines comparability and modération, sketches four related figures, and states a disjunction axiom C5. Two slanted notes ask for a stronger condition and relocation of the disjunction axioms. Several corrections remain materially uncertain.
notes.math_reading_decisions: The possible mismatch between the second figure named in paragraph 2 and the lower diagram node prompted a prime-count check: the paragraph has three ticks, while the lower diagram node has two. Neither was repaired. Comparing the bowed order sign with the visibly straight ≤ after avec prompted shape inspection. The diagram’s geometry and shared right F were taken from the ink. These were transcription checks, not proofs; no theorem was validated.
